drills.name: Wall Serve Progression
drills.description: Players serve into a wall from 15 feet, then 20, then 30, checking toss and contact each rep before backing up. Ten serves per distance.
drills.coachingPoints: Toss in front of your hitting shoulder, firm hand through the middle of the ball.

drills.name: Zone Target Serving
drills.description: Cones mark zones 1, 5, and 6 on the far court. Coach calls a zone; every server has three attempts to land it there. Track team makes.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick your zone before the toss and hold your follow-through toward it.

drills.name: Pressure Serving Ladder
drills.description: Team must make five straight serves in to move up a rung; a miss drops them one rung. First side to the top rung wins.
drills.coachingPoints: Same routine every serve: breathe, toss, contact, especially when the streak is on the line.

drills.name: Partner Platform Pepper
drills.description: Pairs pass back and forth on a flat forearm platform from ten feet, working to 25 consecutive controlled passes without the ball touching the floor.
drills.coachingPoints: Flat platform away from your body, angle it to the target. Legs pass the ball, not arms.

drills.name: Butterfly Serve Receive
drills.description: Continuous loop: serve from one end line, receiver passes to a target at the net, then everyone follows their ball. Server to receiver, receiver to target, target to serving line.
drills.coachingPoints: Beat the ball to your spot and be stopped before contact.

drills.name: Shuffle-and-Pass Windows
drills.description: Passer shuffles between two cones six feet apart; a tosser alternates balls to each cone and the passer must arrive, stop, and pass to target.
drills.coachingPoints: Shuffle, stop, pass. Never swing your platform while you're still moving.

drills.name: Free Ball Call and Convert
drills.description: Coach sends easy free balls over the net; the receiving three must call 'mine,' pass to the setter spot, and convert set-and-hit over the net.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it loud and early. A silent free ball is how easy points get dropped.

drills.name: Setter Triangle
drills.description: Tosser at position 6, setter at the net, target at position 4. Setter squares to target and delivers hittable sets from tosses of varying quality. Ten reps, rotate.
drills.coachingPoints: Square your shoulders to zone 4 and finish with hands extended to the target.

drills.name: Catch-and-Release Setting
drills.description: Pairs set back and forth; beginners briefly catch in the shape above the forehead and release, then progress to clean live contact. Work to 20 in a row.
drills.coachingPoints: Big hands shaped to the ball above your forehead. Push through with legs and wrists.

drills.name: Chase Set Recovery
drills.description: Coach tosses a bad pass away from the net; the setter sprints, gets under it, and delivers a high outside set a hitter can attack. Rotate setters each rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint first, set second. Get your feet there so the set looks normal.

drills.name: Approach Footwork Lines
drills.description: Players rep the three-step spike approach (left-right-left for righties) along the net with a full arm swing and block-touch jump, no ball. Ten approaches each.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow to fast. Big final two steps, both arms swing back then up.

drills.name: Toss-and-Swing Mechanics
drills.description: Hitter self-tosses and swings to a partner across the net or into the floor, focusing on high contact and wrist snap. Ten swings, switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Reach high, contact on top of the ball, snap your wrist over it.

drills.name: Hit Off Live Sets
drills.description: Passer-to-setter-to-hitter line: hitter passes a coach toss, transitions off the net, and attacks the setter's live set. Rotate through all three spots.
drills.coachingPoints: Get off the net after you pass. Start your approach behind the ball, not under it.
skillTags: Hitting: Hitting off a live set

drills.name: Tip and Roll Placement Game
drills.description: Cones mark short, middle, and deep-corner zones. Hitters attack live sets but may only score with tips and roll shots into the called zone.
drills.coachingPoints: Same full approach every time. The tip only fools them if it looks like a swing.

drills.name: Net Shuffle Block Footwork
drills.description: Players shuffle along the net between three marked blocking spots, jumping with a full block at each one. Two lengths of the net, keeping hands up throughout.
drills.coachingPoints: Shuffle without crossing your feet and jump straight up. Never drift into the net.

drills.name: Penetration Pin Blocks
drills.description: Partner stands on a box or across the net holding a ball above the tape; blocker jumps and presses both hands over the net onto the ball. Ten reps, switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Reach over, not up. Press your hands into their side of the net.

drills.name: Read the Hitter
drills.description: Live hitter attacks off a set while one blocker watches approach angle and shoulders to time and position the block. Five attacks, rotate blocker and hitter.
drills.coachingPoints: Read their approach and shoulder. The hitter tells you where the ball is going.

drills.name: Block, Transition, Attack
drills.description: Blocker jumps against a coach attack at the net, lands, transitions off the net, and immediately attacks a set from the setter. Five full cycles each.
drills.coachingPoints: Land, turn, and sprint off the net. The block and the attack are one continuous play.

drills.name: Dig-Set-Hit Continuous
drills.description: Coach attacks at three defenders; they dig to the setter, set, and hit back over, then immediately defend the next attack. Play continuous two-minute rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Low and stopped before the attack. Dig the ball high and to the middle.

drills.name: 6v6 Wash Scrimmage
drills.description: Full-rotation scrimmage where a team must win two rallies in a row (serve rally plus a coach-entered free ball) to earn the point; a split washes to zero.
drills.coachingPoints: Talk every rally. Call the ball, call the hitter, call the coverage.

drills.name: Toss Consistency Reps
drills.description: Servers practice the toss alone with no contact, letting the ball drop to a spot marked on the floor in front of the hitting shoulder. Twenty tosses before any serving.
drills.coachingPoints: Same toss, same spot, every time. If you have to reach for it, catch it and toss again.

drills.name: Standing Float Serve Progression
drills.description: Servers work three stages: contact with no step, then one step, then the full approach, ten serves at each stage from behind the attack line before moving back.
drills.coachingPoints: Firm flat hand, contact the middle of the ball, stop the follow through. No spin means no spin at all.

drills.name: Serve Away from the Best Passer
drills.description: Six receivers line up and the coach names one as the primary passer. Servers have to land the ball away from him without serving out of bounds. Twelve serves each.
drills.coachingPoints: Find the weakest passer and keep going back to him. Away from the libero, not away from the court.

drills.name: Serve the Seam
drills.description: Two passers set up in serve receive and the server has to land the ball in the seam between them so neither one calls it cleanly. Twelve serves each server.
drills.coachingPoints: The seam is the easiest point you'll ever serve. Aim between them, not at either one.

drills.name: Short and Deep Serve Pairs
drills.description: Server alternates a short serve just over the net inside the ten foot line and a deep serve to the back third. Ten pairs, tracking how many land in the correct third.
drills.coachingPoints: Short serve is contacted lower with a softer arm. Deep serve is the same swing from a step further back.

drills.name: Pull the Passer Serving Game
drills.description: Coach calls short or deep at random just before the toss, so the server has to adjust on the fly. Fifteen serves per player, scoring one point per correct depth.
drills.coachingPoints: Adjust with your contact point, not your swing speed. Decide before the toss goes up.

drills.name: Serve to Stay Alive
drills.description: Players serve one at a time and a miss sends them out of the round. Last two servers standing win. Play three rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow your breathing and use your routine. A safe serve in is worth more than an ace attempt out.

drills.name: Match Point Serving
drills.description: Each player steps up needing to make a serve at a called score, with the whole team watching and the coach calling the situation out loud. Three reps per player.
drills.coachingPoints: Same routine at 24-24 as at 5-1. The routine is what holds up under pressure.

drills.name: Platform Angle Holds
drills.description: Players hold a platform against a partner's hands and practice angling the shoulders toward a target without swinging the arms. Twelve holds to three different targets.
drills.coachingPoints: Angle the platform with the shoulders, don't swing at it. Thumbs down and together, elbows locked.

drills.name: Wall Platform Control
drills.description: Passer stands eight feet from a wall and keeps a continuous rally going off it without letting the ball touch the floor. Three sets of twenty-five, resetting the count on any drop.
drills.coachingPoints: Let the ball come to the platform. If you swing, it goes to the ceiling.

drills.name: Pass to the Target Cone
drills.description: Coach tosses from across the net and passers must land the ball inside a cone target at the setter position. Fifteen passes each, counting only balls that land in the target.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass it high enough that the setter can walk under it. Angle, don't swing.

drills.name: Two-Passer Serve Receive
drills.description: Two passers cover the whole court against live serving, calling every ball loudly and early. Twenty serves per pair before rotating.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it before it crosses the net. The player it's coming to takes it, everyone else gets out of the way.

drills.name: Shuffle, Stop, Pass
drills.description: Coach tosses two to three feet to either side and the passer shuffles, stops with both feet planted, and passes. Twenty reps alternating directions.
drills.coachingPoints: Get there and stop, then pass. Passing while you move sends it sideways.

drills.name: Forward and Back Passing Reads
drills.description: Coach mixes short tosses in front of the passer and deep ones over the shoulder so the feet have to move both directions. Twenty reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Move your feet before you drop your platform. On the deep one, turn and run, don't backpedal.

drills.name: Free Ball Transition Pass
drills.description: Coach tosses a free ball over the net, the team calls it loudly, releases off the net, and passes it to the setter. Fifteen reps with the whole rotation on court.
drills.coachingPoints: Call free ball loud, then get off the net. Pass it higher than a serve so everyone can transition.

drills.name: Down Ball and Free Ball Reads
drills.description: Coach either swings a down ball or tosses a free ball, and the defense has to call which one and adjust their base. Twenty reps mixed.
drills.coachingPoints: Free ball means release, down ball means hold your base low. Call the difference out loud.

drills.name: Dig the Hard-Driven Ball
drills.description: Coach hits from a box or the attack line at a defender in a low base position from fifteen feet. Twenty digs, focusing on getting the ball up rather than to a target.
drills.coachingPoints: Low base and still when he contacts. Just get it up high, the second contact fixes everything.

drills.name: Sprawl and Extension Digs
drills.description: Coach tosses balls just out of reach so defenders have to extend and sprawl to the floor. Ten reps each side, teaching the safe landing first with no ball.
drills.coachingPoints: Chest to the floor, chin up, slide on it. Get the platform there first and the body follows.

drills.name: Pursuit to the Pancake
drills.description: Coach tosses short balls into the seams and defenders sprint to slide a flat hand under the ball on the floor. Twelve reps, walking through the hand placement first.
drills.coachingPoints: Flat hand on the floor before the ball lands, not as it lands. Run through it, don't dive at it.

drills.name: Ball on the Forehead Hand Shape
drills.description: Players hold a ball resting on the forehead in the correct hand shape, then push it straight up two feet and catch it in the same shape. Twenty reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Big window between the thumbs and index fingers. Ball touches the pads, never the palms.

drills.name: Wall Setting Repetitions
drills.description: Player sets against a wall from six feet at a consistent height, keeping the ball clean with no spin. Three sets of twenty-five without a miss.
drills.coachingPoints: Push with the legs, finish with the fingers. Spin on the ball means uneven hands.

drills.name: Back Set Accuracy
drills.description: Setter works back sets to a cone target behind him, starting from a toss and progressing to a pass. Fifteen back sets, then fifteen alternating front and back.
drills.coachingPoints: Arch back from the hips, not the neck. Same contact point whether it goes forward or back.

drills.name: Release and Square Up
drills.description: Setter starts in his base position, releases to the setting target on the coach's toss, and squares his shoulders to the left antenna before contact. Twenty reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Beat the ball to the spot, then set. Right foot last, shoulders square to the outside.

drills.name: Three-Position Setter Sprint
drills.description: Setter starts from three different base positions depending on the rotation and sprints to the setting target on each toss. Six reps from each starting spot.
drills.coachingPoints: Know where you start in every rotation. Get there early enough to be stopped when you set.

drills.name: Set from Off the Net
drills.description: Coach passes deliberately five to ten feet off the net and the setter has to deliver a hittable outside set anyway. Fifteen reps at varying distances.
drills.coachingPoints: Off the net means set it higher and further outside. Never set it tight when you're behind the ten foot line.

drills.name: Bump Set Under Pressure
drills.description: Coach sends passes low or behind the setter so he has to use a forearm bump set instead of hands. Twelve reps, then twelve where he chooses which to use.
drills.coachingPoints: If it's below your chest, bump it. High and outside, and the hitter can still swing.

drills.name: Read the Block and Set
drills.description: Coach holds up a number of blockers on one side just before the setter contacts, and the setter has to set the other way. Twenty reps with the look changing each time.
drills.coachingPoints: Peek at the block as the pass comes, not while you're setting. Set away from the numbers.

drills.name: Distribute to the Hot Hitter
drills.description: Three hitters available on every rep, with a coach calling out who is hot. The setter must find that hitter without telegraphing it. Fifteen reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Same body position no matter who you're setting. Get your best hitter the ball in a tight set.

drills.name: Four-Step Approach Rhythm
drills.description: Hitters work the left-right-left approach with no ball, building from a walk to full speed. Twelve reps, then twelve finishing with a jump and a swing at air.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow, slow, quick-quick. Last two steps close fast and the arms swing back and up.

drills.name: Approach to a Moving Ball
drills.description: Coach tosses a ball at varying heights and distances off the net so hitters have to time the approach to the set rather than to a fixed spot. Fifteen approaches, catching the ball at the top.
drills.coachingPoints: Wait for the set to peak before you start. Better to be early and adjust than late and reaching.

drills.name: Arm Swing on the Wall
drills.description: Hitters throw a ball into the floor a few feet from a wall using a full hitting motion so it rebounds off the wall back to them. Twenty-five throws.
drills.coachingPoints: Elbow high and back, snap the wrist over the top. Contact out in front of your hitting shoulder.

drills.name: Standing Swing over the Net
drills.description: Hitters stand at the net on a box or on the floor for shorter players and swing at tossed balls without an approach. Twenty swings focused only on the arm.
drills.coachingPoints: Bow and arrow with the arms, then snap over the ball. Hit it down with topspin, don't slap at it.

drills.name: Hitting Lines from the Pass
drills.description: Full sequence of pass, set, and hit running continuously from both outside positions. Each hitter gets eight swings before rotating.
drills.coachingPoints: Adjust your approach to the set you actually get. Swing at the ball you have, not the one you wanted.
skillTags: Hitting: Hitting off a live set

drills.name: Middle Quick Attack Timing
drills.description: Middle hitter works the quick set timing, starting his approach before the setter contacts the ball. Fifteen reps, adjusting the start point until the timing is clean.
drills.coachingPoints: You go first, the set follows you. Be in the air when he touches it.
skillTags: Hitting: Hitting off a live set

drills.name: Tip, Roll, and Swing Choice
drills.description: Defenders position deep or in the seam and the hitter has to pick a tip, an off-speed roll shot, or a full swing based on what he sees. Twelve reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Look at the floor, not the block. Tip to where they aren't, not just over the block.

drills.name: Hit the Line, Hit the Angle
drills.description: Cones mark a line zone and an angle zone on the far court. Hitter calls which one before each swing and has to land it there. Twelve swings, six of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Turn your shoulders to change the direction, not just your wrist. Call it, then hit it.

drills.name: Block Footwork at the Pin
drills.description: Blockers work a two-step and then a three-step crossover move from the pin to the middle, jumping and landing under control at the end of each. Ten reps of each pattern.
drills.coachingPoints: Open with the lead foot, crossover, then square up before you jump. Never jump while you are still drifting.

drills.name: Mirror the Middle
drills.description: Middle blocker mirrors a coach moving along the far side of the net, closing to whichever pin he goes to and jumping on the whistle. Twelve reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Move when the ball is set, not when the hitter starts. Close the seam with the outside blocker.

drills.name: Press Over the Net
drills.description: Blockers jump and press their hands over the net at a coach holding a ball on the other side, holding the shape for the full jump. Fifteen reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands over and angled in toward the court. Thumbs up, fingers spread, shoulders shrugged to the ears.

drills.name: Seal the Line Block
drills.description: Outside blocker sets the outside hand to take away the line while a coach hits down the line from a box. Ten reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Outside hand turns the ball back into the court. Foot on the antenna side, don't drift in.

drills.name: Watch Ball, Setter, Hitter
drills.description: Blockers call out loud what they are watching in sequence as a live rep develops: ball, then setter, then hitter. Fifteen reps with the coach checking their eyes.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball, setter, hitter, in that order every time. Never stare at the ball the whole way.

drills.name: Read the Approach Angle
drills.description: Hitters attack from varied approach angles and blockers have to predict line or angle from the approach path before the swing. Fifteen reps, scoring correct predictions.
drills.coachingPoints: His approach angle tells you where the ball goes. Sharp approach means angle, straight on means line.

drills.name: Block, Land, Approach
drills.description: Blocker jumps at the net, lands under control, immediately backs off the net, and takes a full attack approach. Twelve reps at game speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Land facing the net, then push off and get off the net. Be off the net before the set goes up.

drills.name: Block to Dig to Attack
drills.description: Blockers jump, land, and then the coach immediately hits a ball behind them that they have to dig before transitioning to attack. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Land and turn, don't land and watch. The ball behind you is yours the second you're down.

drills.name: Court Sprint and Shuffle Grid
drills.description: Players sprint to the attack line, shuffle across the court, backpedal to the end line, and shuffle back. Four circuits with rest between.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay low through the shuffles, no standing up. Touch every line with a hand.

drills.name: Block Jump Repeats
drills.description: Players perform ten consecutive block jumps at the net with a controlled landing on each, then rest ninety seconds. Three sets.
drills.coachingPoints: Land soft with bent knees every rep. When the jumps get low, the set is over.

drills.name: Approach Jump and Stick
drills.description: Players take a full attack approach, jump as high as they can, and stick the landing without stumbling. Eight reps with full rest between each.
drills.coachingPoints: Swing the arms back and up hard. Stick the landing, no extra steps.

drills.name: Continuous Six-Ball Defense
drills.description: Coach sends six balls in a row at one defender with no break: a hard-driven ball, a tip, a deep ball, a short ball, a seam ball, and a free ball. Two rounds each.
drills.coachingPoints: Play every ball, then reset low. The sixth one counts the same as the first.

drills.name: Long Rally Conditioning
drills.description: Six-on-six where the coach immediately enters a new ball the moment a rally ends, so play never stops. Four-minute blocks with two minutes rest, three blocks.
drills.coachingPoints: Communicate more when you are tired. Get back to base after every single contact.

drills.name: Reaction Ball Drop
drills.description: Partner holds a ball at shoulder height and drops it without warning from eight feet. The defender has to get a platform under it before the second bounce. Fifteen reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of your feet and ready. Go on the drop, not on the bounce.

drills.name: Serve Receive Rotation Walk-Through
drills.description: Team walks through serve receive alignment for all six rotations, with each player naming who they overlap with. Two full trips through the rotations.
drills.coachingPoints: Know who you have to stay behind and beside. Get to your spot before the server is ready.

drills.name: Rotation Under Live Serve
drills.description: Team runs each rotation against live serving, playing the ball out to a terminal contact before rotating. Three passes through all six rotations.
drills.coachingPoints: Seams belong to somebody, decide before the serve. Release to your attack position as soon as you pass.

drills.name: Hitter Coverage Shape
drills.description: Every time a teammate attacks, the other five drop into a coverage cup behind him to play the blocked ball. Fifteen reps with the coach blocking balls back.
drills.coachingPoints: Low and close behind your hitter. Every blocked ball should hit somebody's platform.

drills.name: Base to Defense Transition
drills.description: Defenders start in base position and move to their perimeter defensive spots as the coach sets to different hitters. Twenty reps with the set direction changing each time.
drills.coachingPoints: Base first, then read and move. Stop your feet before he contacts the ball.

drills.name: Dig to Transition Attack
drills.description: Defense digs a hard-driven ball and must convert it into a full three-contact attack. Fifteen reps, scoring only when the transition swing is in.
drills.coachingPoints: Dig it high to buy time. Hitters get off the net the second the dig goes up.

drills.name: Wash Drill Three Balls
drills.description: Coach enters three balls in a row for the same team: a serve, a free ball, and a down ball. Winning two of three wins the wash and a point. Play to five points.
drills.coachingPoints: Win the second ball, that's where matches are decided. Reset your base between every entry.

drills.name: Talk Before Every Contact
drills.description: Live six-on-six where the coach stops play and awards the point to the other team any time a ball lands without somebody having called it. Play to ten.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it before you touch it, every contact. Silence means it lands between two of you.

drills.name: Jump Float Serve Progression
drills.description: Servers build the jump float in three stages: toss and catch with no jump, toss with a one-step hop, then the full two-step jump. Eight serves at each stage.
drills.coachingPoints: Toss it out in front so you jump to the ball. Firm hand, short punch, no follow through.

drills.name: Serve and Sprint to Base
drills.description: Server serves, then immediately sprints onto the court to his defensive base position before the ball would come back. Twelve reps.
drills.coachingPoints: You are not done when you serve, you are a defender now. Get to your base low and ready.

drills.name: Six-Zone Serving Ladder
drills.description: Server must hit zone one, then two, and on through all six in order. A miss sends him back one zone. Two full ladders per player.
drills.coachingPoints: Change the zone with your shoulders and your toss, not your swing. Same swing every serve.

drills.name: Team Serving Goal
drills.description: Team has to make twenty-five serves in a row as a group, and any miss resets the count to zero. One attempt per practice.
drills.coachingPoints: Your teammates are counting on the serve being in. Routine, breathe, safe target.

drills.name: Back Row Attack from Ten Feet
drills.description: Back row hitters approach from behind the attack line and swing at a set delivered to the ten foot line. Ten swings each, checking that the takeoff is behind the line.
drills.coachingPoints: Take off behind the line, land wherever you want. Hit it deep, not down.
skillTags: Hitting: Hitting off a live set

drills.name: Swing at the Tight Set
drills.description: Setter deliberately delivers sets tight to the net and the hitter has to use a high hands shot or a sharp cut rather than a full swing into the block. Twelve reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Tight set means use their hands or cut it sharp. Never swing hard into a set on the net.

drills.name: Two-Blocker Seam Close
drills.description: Middle and outside blockers close together on the pin and a coach tries to hit the seam between their hands. Twelve reps each side, counting clean closes.
drills.coachingPoints: Middle closes to the outside, outside holds the antenna. Inside hands touch or you left a seam.

drills.name: Shuttle and Dig Circuit
drills.description: Player shuttles end line to attack line twice, then immediately digs three balls the coach sends at varying depths. Four rounds each with ninety seconds rest.
drills.coachingPoints: Get stopped before the ball is hit, even when you are gassed. Low base, platform ready.
